children.value: > Fact From Story: David Marcus said he would never again attend, sponsor or speak at another Web Summit event.

> > Fact From Story: The Israeli ambassador to Portugal, Dor Shapiro, wrote to the Mayor of Lisbon informing him that Israel will not participate in the WebSummit conference due to the outrageous statements made by the conference CEO Paddy Cosgrave.
> > Fact From Story: Ori Goshen, the co-founder and co-CEO of AI21 Labs, announced on LinkedIn that he would no longer be giving a keynote at Web Summit.
> > > Fact From Story: Keith Rabois chimed in that he will refuse to work with anyone who speaks at this conference in Qatar for the rest of his career.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Losing speakers and participants harms a conference.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Losing speakers and participants harms a conference.

> Fact From Story: Founders, investors and others from the technology community in Israel have gone ballistic over comments made by the founder and figurehead of Web Summit, Paddy Cosgrave, related to the fighting underway across Israel and Gaza, specifically his criticism of Israel’s retaliatory actions.

> > Fact From Story: The situation also highlights how Israel’s tech industry, the country’s most valuable and arguably best-known export, built on business development and relationships, has been willing to cut those ties in the battle of public opinion in this most polarizing of conflicts.
> > > > > Fact From Story: The anger with Cosgrave has gone viral, and today it looked like it was about to overrun promotion efforts for Web Summit. | Fact From Story
> > > > > Fact From Story: “Here in Israel, we’re basically now in rage mode after the first week of shock and awe,” one tech source told TechCrunch. | Fact From Story
> > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Viral anger can quickly and significantly damage relationships between people and organizations. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A strong negative reaction from a key industry can significantly impact an event or organization.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Public criticism and boycotts can damage a brand's reputation and success.
